item.title: The Dating App Match That Ended in an Alleged Murder-for-Hire Plot
item.description: Aimee Betro flew from the US to Birmingham and allegedly became part of a revenge plot against a rival family. Disguised in a niqab, she pulled a gun at point-blank range—but it jammed. What followed was a bizarre case involving a dating app, CCTV footage, threatening texts, and years on the run.

item.title: They Put Him in Boxes! *Simon Shotton*
item.description: Simon Shotton, 49, was murdered in Bournemouth, England, in August 2023 by Benjamin Atkins, who later dismembered his body and scattered the remains across several locations near the seafront. Police identified Simon after members of the public discovered body parts, eventually tracing the case back to Atkins’ home. Atkins claimed self-defense, but a jury convicted him of murder. His minimum prison term was later increased to 21 years. How did this horrific crime remain hidden until Simon’s remains began appearing in public?
